chapterInfo.content:
21
Israelfoɔ sɛe Kanaanfoɔ
1Na Arad hene a ɔyɛ Kanaanni a ɔte Negeb no tee sɛ Israel aba Atarim kwan soɔ no, ɔne Israel bɛkoe, na ɔfaa wɔn mu binom nnommum. 2#Deut 13.15; Yos 6.17; Ate 1.17; 1 Sa 15.3 Ɛnna Israel hyɛɛ AWURADE bɔ sɛ: Sɛ wode ɔman yi hyɛ yɛn nsa a, yɛbɛsɛe wɔn nkuro pasapasa. 3#Num 14.45 Na AWURADE tiee Israel nne, na ɔde Kanaanfoɔ no mae, na wɔsɛee wɔn ne wɔn nkuro pasapasa, na wɔfrɛɛ hɔ sɛ: Horma.#21.3 HORMA: Hebri asekyerɛ ne: Ɔsɛeɛ.
Kɔbere ɔwɔ
4 # Num 11.1-6; 14.2 Na wɔtu firii Hor bepɔ ho faa Mmɛwa Po kwan so sɛ wɔretwa Edom asase ho kɔntɔnkrɔn akɔ. Na ɔman no ahome tee wɔn ho pii ɔkwan no so. 5Na ɔman no kasa tiaa Onyankopɔn ne Mose sɛ: Adɛn nti na moyii yɛn firii Misraim sɛ yɛmmɛwuwu ɛserɛ soɔ? Na aduane biara nni hɔ, na nsuo biara nso nni hɔ, na aduane hunu yi afono yɛn. 6#1 Ko 10.9 Ɛnna AWURADE somaa awɔ a wɔn ano wɔ borɔ baa ɔman no mu bɛkekaa ɔman no, na Israel mu nnipa pii wuwui.
7Ɛnna ɔman no baa Mose nkyɛn bɛkaa sɛ: Yɛayɛ bɔne sɛ yɛkasa tiaa AWURADE ne woɔ; pa AWURADE kyɛw na ɔmmɛyi awɔ no mfiri yɛn so. Na Mose paa kyɛw maa ɔman no. 8#Yoh 3.14 Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Yɛ ɔwɔ a n’ano wɔ borɔ nsɛsoɔ, na fa no sɛne frankaa dua so; na obiara a ebi aka no no, sɛ ɔhwɛ a, ɔbɛnya nkwa. 9Na Mose yɛɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ɔwɔ no, na ɔde no sɛnee frankaa dua no so, na sɛ ɔwɔ ka obi na ɔhwɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ɔwɔ no a, na wanya nkwa.
Israelfoɔ toa wɔn akwantuo no so
10Na Israelfoɔ no tu kɔkyeree nsraban wɔ Obot. 11Na wɔtu firii Obot kɔkyeree nsraban Iye-haabarim, ɛserɛ a ɛwɔ Moab anim, owia puebea no so. 12Ɛhɔ na wɔfiri tu kɔkyeree nsraban wɔ Sared subonhwa mu. 13Ɛhɔ na wɔfiri tu kɔkyeree nsraban wɔ Asubɔnten Arnon a ɛsene serɛ soɔ a ɛfiri Amori hyeɛ soɔ no agya, ɛfiri sɛ Arnon ne ɛhyeɛ a ɛda Moab ne Amori ntam. 14#Yos 10.13 Enti wɔka no AWURADE akodie nwoma no mu sɛ:
Wɔnam ahumtuo so ko faa Waheb
ne Arnon nsubɔnhwa no,
15ne deɛ nsubɔnhwa no sene a
ɛdane kɔ Ar tenabea
na ɛtwere Moab hyeɛ ho no.
16Ɛhɔ na wɔfiri kɔɔ Beer, asubura a AWURADE kaa ho asɛm kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Boa ɔman no ano na mɛma wɔn nsuo anom, no. 17Ɛberɛ no mu na Israel too dwom yi sɛ:
Asubura, tue! Monnye no so!
18Asubura a atitire tuiɛ
na ɔman mu mmapɔmma funufunuiɛ,
wɔde ahempoma ne wɔn mpoma.
Na wɔfiri serɛ so kɔɔ Matana; 19na wɔfiri Matana kɔɔ Nahaliel; na wɔfiri Nahaliel kɔɔ Bamot; 20na wɔfiri Bamot kɔɔ bonhwa a ɛwɔ Moab petee mu, Pisga atifi a ɛkyerɛ anwea pradada soɔ no mu.
Wɔdi Sihon ne Og so nkonim
21 # Deut 2.26-37 Na Israel somaa abɔfoɔ kɔɔ Amorifoɔ hene Sihon nkyɛn kɔkaa sɛ: 22#Num 20.17 Ma memfa w’asase so; yɛremmane mfuo mu ne nturo mu, yɛrennom abura mu nsuo bi; ɔhene tempɔn so na yɛbɛnanteɛ akɔsi sɛ yɛbɛtwam w’asase soɔ. 23Na Sihon amma Israel antwam n’asase so; na ɔboaa ne man nyinaa ano firi bɛhyiaa Israel, ɛserɛ so, na ɔbaa Yahas ne Israel bɛkoe. 24Na Israel kumm no nkrantɛ ano faa n’asase firi Arnon kɔɔ Yabok so kɔduruu Amonfoɔ ho, ɛfiri sɛ na Amonfoɔ no hyeɛ so hɔ yɛ den. 25Na Israel faa nkuro yi nyinaa, na Israel tenaa Amorifoɔ nkuro no nyinaa mu, Hesbon ne ɛho nkuro nyinaa mu; 26na Hesbon ne Amorifoɔ hene Sihon kuro, ɔno na ɔne kane Moabhene koeɛ, na ɔgyee ne nsam n’asase nyinaa kɔsii Arnon ano. 27Ɛno nti na mmebufoɔ no ka sɛ:
Mommra Hesbon!
Momma wɔnkyekye na wɔnsiesie Sihon kuro no.
28Na ogya bi firii Hesbon,
ogyaframa firii Sihon kuro kɛseɛ mu;
ɛhyee Moab kuro Ar,
Arnon sorɔnsorɔmmea so awuranom.
29 # Ate 11.24; 1 Ah 11.7 Wo Moab, due!
Kemos man, moayera!
Wama ne mmammarima adwanedwane,
na ne mmammaa adane
Amorifoɔ hene Sihon nnommum.
30Na yɛabɔ wɔn agu, Hesbon ayera akɔduru Dibon;
yɛasɛe wɔn akɔfa Nofa
de akɔduru Medeba.
31Na Israelfoɔ no tenaa Amorifoɔ asase so. 32Na Mose somaa maa wɔkɔsraa Yaser, na wɔfaa ne nkuraa, na ɔtuu Amorifoɔ a wɔwɔ hɔ no. 33#Deut 3.1-11 Na wɔdanee wɔn ho foro kɔɔ Basan kwan so. Na Basan hene Og firii adi bɛhyiaa wɔn, ɔno ne ne man nyinaa, sɛ wɔrebɛko wɔ Edrei. 34#Dwom 136.17-22 Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Nsuro no, na mede no ne ne man nyinaa ne n’asase mahyɛ wo nsa, na woayɛ no sɛdeɛ woyɛɛ Amorifoɔ hene Sihon a ɔtenaa Hesbon no. 35Na wɔkunkum no ne ne mma ne ne man nyinaa a obiara antumi anya kwan anwanne, na wɔfaa asase no dii so.

Na Arad hene a ɔyɛ Kanaanni a ɔte Negeb no tee sɛ Israel aba Atarim kwan soɔ no, ɔne Israel bɛkoe, na ɔfaa wɔn mu binom nnommum. Ɛnna Israel hyɛɛ AWURADE bɔ sɛ: Sɛ wode ɔman yi hyɛ yɛn nsa a, yɛbɛsɛe wɔn nkuro pasapasa. Na AWURADE tiee Israel nne, na ɔde Kanaanfoɔ no mae, na wɔsɛee wɔn ne wɔn nkuro pasapasa, na wɔfrɛɛ hɔ sɛ: Horma.

Na wɔtu firii Hor bepɔ ho faa Mmɛwa Po kwan so sɛ wɔretwa Edom asase ho kɔntɔnkrɔn akɔ. Na ɔman no ahome tee wɔn ho pii ɔkwan no so. Na ɔman no kasa tiaa Onyankopɔn ne Mose sɛ: Adɛn nti na moyii yɛn firii Misraim sɛ yɛmmɛwuwu ɛserɛ soɔ? Na aduane biara nni hɔ, na nsuo biara nso nni hɔ, na aduane hunu yi afono yɛn. Ɛnna AWURADE somaa awɔ a wɔn ano wɔ borɔ baa ɔman no mu bɛkekaa ɔman no, na Israel mu nnipa pii wuwui.
Ɛnna ɔman no baa Mose nkyɛn bɛkaa sɛ: Yɛayɛ bɔne sɛ yɛkasa tiaa AWURADE ne woɔ; pa AWURADE kyɛw na ɔmmɛyi awɔ no mfiri yɛn so. Na Mose paa kyɛw maa ɔman no. Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Yɛ ɔwɔ a n’ano wɔ borɔ nsɛsoɔ, na fa no sɛne frankaa dua so; na obiara a ebi aka no no, sɛ ɔhwɛ a, ɔbɛnya nkwa. Na Mose yɛɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ɔwɔ no, na ɔde no sɛnee frankaa dua no so, na sɛ ɔwɔ ka obi na ɔhwɛ kɔbere mfrafraeɛ ɔwɔ no a, na wanya nkwa.

Na Israelfoɔ no tu kɔkyeree nsraban wɔ Obot. Na wɔtu firii Obot kɔkyeree nsraban Iye-haabarim, ɛserɛ a ɛwɔ Moab anim, owia puebea no so. Ɛhɔ na wɔfiri tu kɔkyeree nsraban wɔ Sared subonhwa mu. Ɛhɔ na wɔfiri tu kɔkyeree nsraban wɔ Asubɔnten Arnon a ɛsene serɛ soɔ a ɛfiri Amori hyeɛ soɔ no agya, ɛfiri sɛ Arnon ne ɛhyeɛ a ɛda Moab ne Amori ntam. Enti wɔka no AWURADE akodie nwoma no mu sɛ:
Wɔnam ahumtuo so ko faa Waheb
ne Arnon nsubɔnhwa no,
ne deɛ nsubɔnhwa no sene a
ɛdane kɔ Ar tenabea
na ɛtwere Moab hyeɛ ho no.
Ɛhɔ na wɔfiri kɔɔ Beer, asubura a AWURADE kaa ho asɛm kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Boa ɔman no ano na mɛma wɔn nsuo anom, no. Ɛberɛ no mu na Israel too dwom yi sɛ:
Asubura, tue! Monnye no so!
Asubura a atitire tuiɛ
na ɔman mu mmapɔmma funufunuiɛ,
wɔde ahempoma ne wɔn mpoma.
Na wɔfiri serɛ so kɔɔ Matana; na wɔfiri Matana kɔɔ Nahaliel; na wɔfiri Nahaliel kɔɔ Bamot; na wɔfiri Bamot kɔɔ bonhwa a ɛwɔ Moab petee mu, Pisga atifi a ɛkyerɛ anwea pradada soɔ no mu.

Na Israel somaa abɔfoɔ kɔɔ Amorifoɔ hene Sihon nkyɛn kɔkaa sɛ: Ma memfa w’asase so; yɛremmane mfuo mu ne nturo mu, yɛrennom abura mu nsuo bi; ɔhene tempɔn so na yɛbɛnanteɛ akɔsi sɛ yɛbɛtwam w’asase soɔ. Na Sihon amma Israel antwam n’asase so; na ɔboaa ne man nyinaa ano firi bɛhyiaa Israel, ɛserɛ so, na ɔbaa Yahas ne Israel bɛkoe. Na Israel kumm no nkrantɛ ano faa n’asase firi Arnon kɔɔ Yabok so kɔduruu Amonfoɔ ho, ɛfiri sɛ na Amonfoɔ no hyeɛ so hɔ yɛ den. Na Israel faa nkuro yi nyinaa, na Israel tenaa Amorifoɔ nkuro no nyinaa mu, Hesbon ne ɛho nkuro nyinaa mu; na Hesbon ne Amorifoɔ hene Sihon kuro, ɔno na ɔne kane Moabhene koeɛ, na ɔgyee ne nsam n’asase nyinaa kɔsii Arnon ano. Ɛno nti na mmebufoɔ no ka sɛ:
Mommra Hesbon!
Momma wɔnkyekye na wɔnsiesie Sihon kuro no.
Na ogya bi firii Hesbon,
ogyaframa firii Sihon kuro kɛseɛ mu;
ɛhyee Moab kuro Ar,
Arnon sorɔnsorɔmmea so awuranom.
Wo Moab, due!
Kemos man, moayera!
Wama ne mmammarima adwanedwane,
na ne mmammaa adane
Amorifoɔ hene Sihon nnommum.
Na yɛabɔ wɔn agu, Hesbon ayera akɔduru Dibon;
yɛasɛe wɔn akɔfa Nofa
de akɔduru Medeba.
Na Israelfoɔ no tenaa Amorifoɔ asase so. Na Mose somaa maa wɔkɔsraa Yaser, na wɔfaa ne nkuraa, na ɔtuu Amorifoɔ a wɔwɔ hɔ no. Na wɔdanee wɔn ho foro kɔɔ Basan kwan so. Na Basan hene Og firii adi bɛhyiaa wɔn, ɔno ne ne man nyinaa, sɛ wɔrebɛko wɔ Edrei. Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Nsuro no, na mede no ne ne man nyinaa ne n’asase mahyɛ wo nsa, na woayɛ no sɛdeɛ woyɛɛ Amorifoɔ hene Sihon a ɔtenaa Hesbon no. Na wɔkunkum no ne ne mma ne ne man nyinaa a obiara antumi anya kwan anwanne, na wɔfaa asase no dii so.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
